name: blueprint
what: Blueprint PNGs: project layout plus model, vfx and animation sheets (every step, basics, gates, files)
run: node tools/art/blueprint/render.cjs -> tools/art/blueprint/out/project-blueprint.png (exits 1 on overflow or page error)
